code:
No audit logging
  -> can't investigate a prompt-injection incident
  -> can't investigate a disparate-outcome complaint

No model card / data provenance
  -> nothing to audit for a security weakness
  -> nothing to audit for a fairness complaint

Same governance gap. Two labels on one failure.
caption: A biased model and an insecure model are often the same root cause.

eyebrow: Red-teaming and bias auditing: the same test
code:
Red-teaming (Lesson 25):
  probe with adversarial input -> check output vs. policy

Bias audit:
  probe with varied input -> check output doesn't differ
                              in ways it shouldn't

Same methodology. Different risk category.
Skipping one is testing half the risk.
caption: One governance program, one board, one category of testing — not two.
